label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
verse: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
note: Peter quotes the second half: charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I will _____ my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
verse: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
note: After Israel's shepherds failed, God says He'll do it Himself: I will feed my flock.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So that from his body were brought unto the sick _____ or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
verse: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
note: Even Paul's handkerchiefs and aprons carried healing in Ephesus — the most unusual laundry in Acts.

label: Deep Water
prompt: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the _____ of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
verse: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
note: David's one-item wish list: not victory or wealth, but time in God's house gazing at his beauty.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Moreover it is required in _____, that a man be found faithful.
verse: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.
note: The one qualification Paul lists for stewards: not talent, not charisma — just being found faithful.
